title: Grape Pilaf Casserole
description: A flavorful and colorful gluten-free dish featuring pilaf, tomatoes, and grapes. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced tomatoes and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the halved grapes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pilaf, tomato-grape mixture, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the casserole is lightly browned and heated through.
